setup: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates postgresql-client
warmup: getent hosts meilisearch >/dev/null || printf '127.0.0.1 meilisearch\n' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts >/dev/null
npx24 --yes corepack yarn workspace @linkwarden/web exec playwright install --only-shell chromium
install: getent hosts meilisearch >/dev/null || printf '127.0.0.1 meilisearch\n' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts >/dev/null
npx24 --yes corepack yarn workspace @linkwarden/web exec playwright install --only-shell chromium

db.cmd: docker start -a linkwarden-db || exec docker run --name linkwarden-db -e POSTGRES_USER -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD -e POSTGRES_DB -e POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD -v linkwarden-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data -p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432 postgres:16-alpine

search.cmd: docker start -a linkwarden-search || exec docker run --name linkwarden-search -e MEILI_MASTER_KEY -e MEILI_ENV -v linkwarden-meilidata:/meili_data -p 7700:7700 getmeili/meilisearch:v1.13.3

web.cmd: timeout 120 sh -c 'until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -q; do sleep 1; done' && npx --yes corepack yarn prisma:deploy && exec npx --yes corepack yarn workspace @linkwarden/web dev -H 0.0.0.0 -p "$PORT"

worker.cmd: timeout 180 sh -c 'until curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/config >/dev/null && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:7700/health >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' && exec npx --yes corepack yarn worker:dev
